chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, who said:
I saw a blue pallium upon Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan, a title for Imam Al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him).
key_terms.أَزْرَقَ: Blue, referring to the color of the garment.
key_terms.طَيْلَسَاناً: A type of cloak or shawl worn without sleeves, often used as a head covering.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Hasan (AS) wear according to Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the practical simplicity and modesty of Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who wore a blue 'taylasun' (a woolen cloak) without excessive ornamentation, reflecting the Shia emphasis on humility over ostentatious display. It is frequently cited in fiqh discussions regarding the permissibility and preference of wearing dyed garments, particularly indigo, as a Sunnah of the Imams. This report underscores the balance between maintaining dignity and avoiding the extravagance associated with the elite of the time.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from sahl Bin ZIyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus who said,
‘I saw a blue pallium upon Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 11. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus who has said the following: “
I saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wearing al-Taylisan (pallium) of blue color.’”
